title: Negative scenario — a ROLLBACK that leaves an RLS policy on storage.objects
description: Harness self-proof: migration 38 creates its RLS policies on storage.objects, so a catalog sweep scoped to the public schema observes nothing for it — that fixture measured 15 -> 15 -> 15 objects and a rollback removing no policies would still have passed. Here the apply stage creates a policy on storage.objects and the rollback drops a policy that never existed, exiting 0 and leaving the real one in place. The symmetry check must fail with the rollback exit code (30). Registered as expect-failure so narrowing the sweep back to public turns CI red.
